text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It was a regular day just like any other.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I've finished my incline dashes!

text_block_list.name: Voice from the East
text_block_list.text:
Great... Just great. The track's closed
off... What to do?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Sounds like somebody's in
trouble... Trainer,
I'll be back in a sec—

text_block_list.name: Voice from the West
text_block_list.text:
Someone, help! It's Gold Ship! Gold Ship
just—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wha?! Someone needs help over there
too!
Wh-what should I do?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Th-thanks a ton! I'll go over to help as
soon as I
can!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black is always ready to lend a
hand to
others. That day, she kept
helping people one
after another until
finally...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I'm glad we were able to help
everyone
with their problems.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Only because you pitched in too,
Trainer!
choice_data_list: You got in a solid training session, too.
You got in a solid training session, too.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Sorry for dragging you into all that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black never has any ulterior
motives.
Instead, she helps others for the
sheer sake of
helping them. It's only
natural to want to support
someone so
purely altruistic.
choice_data_list: Honestly, it's an honor to be able to help.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
choice_data_list: Make sure to rest up today.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Um, Trainer? Are you heading straight
home?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh... I see...
choice_data_list: I'm going to work a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'm coming in!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Well, you see...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Kita the traveling masseuse is here to
help you
relax, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yep! As you might already know, I'm a
pretty
good masseuse!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
My mom taught her special massage
techniques
to me. Thanks to her, I
always felt great when I
was growing up!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Now, I'd like you to experience the skill
I've
honed!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: But you're not making me do anything. I want to help you...
choice_data_list: I can't let you do something like that.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You know, Trainer, I'm always looking
for ways to
support you.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's why I always want to thank you,
see if
there's anything bothering you,
and try to find
ways to help...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
And I can give pretty mean massages,
y'know! So
is it okay? Or...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Really?! Then leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oookay! Where would you like me to
work on?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Sure thing! Here I go!
choice_data_list: Ask them to work on your lower back.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hup! Hup! C'mon, leg muscles! Loosen up!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
And to help you run faster, I'll... Wait,
you don't
need that, do you, Trainer?
Hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her gratitude comes across in each
strong press,
soothing both my muscles
and spirit...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Sure thing! Would you lay face down,
please?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Well, Trainer? What do you think?
...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Hehehe, out like a light. Sleep well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her gentle massage puts me into a deep
slumber,
soothing both my muscles and
spirit...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Sure thing! Hold on, let me get behind
you.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hup... Hup... Well? Am I good at this or what?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
People line up to get shoulder massages
from
yours truly all the time. Also—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She entertains me with stories from her
past as
she works my shoulders, soothing
both my
muscles and spirit...
